decisions.reason: As a newly launched product close to the firm’s established prescription portfolio, its uncertainty is still unresolved and the option value of learning further likely exceeds the near-term carrying cost.

Because this generic antidepressant is distant from the firm’s core offer, likely faces tough price competition and reimbursement pressure, and competes for attention with several other new options, management would be relatively likely to discontinue it.

This combination antihypertensive line is close to the firm’s established business and already appears developed as a broader product line, so the firm is likely to preserve the option and build scale rather than exit early.

The bone and joint supplement fits the firm’s aim to expand differentiated self-care and pharmacy products, and its lower development and retention burden makes it worth keeping while demand becomes clearer.
